verdict.rationale: Docs show official Python code (create_fts_index, to_pydantic) and TypeScript/JavaScript code (table.search().toArray(), arrow fields), plus Rust examples. They also refer to "multi-language SDK support" and API keys that work "in every SDK", and a community user confirms using the npm package. That covers only half of the story's named languages. Missing for 10: any evidence of official Go or Java SDKs, independent corroboration of SDK quality and parity.
